asked.item: Another way to get help faster

verdict.reason: The FAQ says Blotato does not offer Zoom calls and that support happens in the in-app chat, where the customer can share screenshots or screen recordings.

steps.text: Blotato does not offer Zoom calls, phone calls, or live meetings with customers.
All support happens in the in-app chat.
In the chat, describe what you are trying to do, and share screenshots or screen recordings of where you are stuck.
